speaker: Penny
text: Sheldon, come in. There's some in the fridge.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Thank you. I'd like to make a sandwich, but I'm out of bread. You shouldn't keep your bread in the refrigerator. Stale-ness is caused by crystallization of the starch molecules, which occurs faster at cool temperatures.

speaker: Penny
text: On Earth, we say thank you.

speaker: Sheldon
text: So, Leonard, how goes the mimesis? You know, mimesis. An action in which the mimic takes on the properties of a specific object or organism. Mimesis.

speaker: Leonard
text: Oh, mimesis? The hell are you talking about?

speaker: Sheldon
text: I'm attempting to communicate with you without my meaning becoming apparent to those around you. Let me try again. Have the indigenous fauna accepted you as one of their own?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Good. FYI, after I eat my sandwich, I'm taking Peter Pauli's petang kite out for a test run. Would you like to get your Delta Wing Raptor and join me?

speaker: Leonard
text: I don't want to fly kites, Sheldon. We're watching football here.

speaker: Sheldon
text: I can see that. I was providing you with an alternative. Courtesy I was never offered in similar circumstances.
